answer_sql:
SELECT
  dc.country_name AS country,
  SUM(sl.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cust
  ON sl.customer_key = cust.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS st
  ON sl.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS dc
  ON cust.country_code = dc.country_code
WHERE
  cust.country_code = st.country_code
GROUP BY
  dc.country_name
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
